title: Exotic Crunchy Syrian Lamb Tagine
description: A garlicky and comforting Syrian dish featuring full fat sour cream, cooked to perfection in a tagine, and served in a lacquerware bowl. This recipe combines the flavors of the Middle East with a crunchy texture.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the lacquerware bowl over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sour cream, chopped almonds, and dried apricots, and stir to combine.
Transfer the bowl to the oven and cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 hours.
Remove the bowl from the oven and season with salt to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
